name: Lack of segregation of duties -> misappropriation fraud risk
rationale: Incompatible functions in one person's hands remove the independent check between a transaction and its concealment - the classic opportunity condition for asset misappropriation. Fraud rules run first (priority 5) so fraud-focused responses are planned before standard procedures.
